name: microsoft-365-planner
label: Microsoft 365 Planner
description: Microsoft 365 Planner is part of the Microsoft 365 suite, offering lightweight task and bucket-based planning for teams. This integration supports creating plans, buckets, tasks, fetching them, deleting them, and custom API calls.

oauth2.scope: Tasks.ReadWrite User.Read User.ReadBasic.All Group.Read.All openid email profile offline_access

createBucket.label: Create Bucket
createBucket.description: Create a bucket (category) under a plan.

name.label: Bucket Name
name.description: The name of the bucket to be created

orderHint.label: Order Hint
orderHint.description: Hint used to order items of this type in a list. The format is defined as outlined here: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/planner-order-hint-format?view=graph-rest-1.0

title.label: Title
title.description: The title of the plan to search for

getABucket.label: Get a Bucket
getABucket.description: Retrieve details about a specific bucket.

title.label: Title
title.description: The title of the task to search for

microsoft_365_planner_list_plans.label: List Plans
microsoft_365_planner_list_plans.description: Lists your Planner plans, or the plans of a group.

groupId.label: Group ID
groupId.description: Only list the plans of this Microsoft 365 group (from List Groups). Leave empty for every plan shared with you.

titleContains.label: Title Contains
titleContains.description: Only return plans whose title contains this text (case-insensitive).

microsoft_365_planner_get_plan.label: Get Plan
microsoft_365_planner_get_plan.description: Gets a Planner plan by ID.

planId.label: Plan ID
planId.description: Planner plan ID. Use List Plans to find it.

microsoft_365_planner_create_plan.label: Create Plan
microsoft_365_planner_create_plan.description: Creates a Planner plan owned by a Microsoft 365 group.

groupId.label: Group ID
groupId.description: ID (GUID) of a Microsoft 365 group. Use List Groups to find it.

microsoft_365_planner_get_plan_details.label: Get Plan Details
microsoft_365_planner_get_plan_details.description: Gets a plan’s category labels and sharing.

planId.label: Plan ID
planId.description: Planner plan ID. Use List Plans to find it.

microsoft_365_planner_list_buckets.label: List Buckets
microsoft_365_planner_list_buckets.description: Lists the buckets of a Planner plan.

planId.label: Plan ID
planId.description: Planner plan ID. Use List Plans to find it.

microsoft_365_planner_get_bucket.label: Get Bucket
microsoft_365_planner_get_bucket.description: Gets a Planner bucket by ID.

bucketId.label: Bucket ID
bucketId.description: Planner bucket ID. Use List Buckets to find it.

microsoft_365_planner_create_bucket.label: Create Bucket
microsoft_365_planner_create_bucket.description: Creates a bucket in a Planner plan.

planId.label: Plan ID
planId.description: Planner plan ID. Use List Plans to find it.

orderHint.label: Order Hint
orderHint.description: Optional Planner order hint that positions the bucket, e.g. " !" to put it first. Leave empty to add it at the end.

microsoft_365_planner_list_plan_tasks.label: List Plan Tasks
microsoft_365_planner_list_plan_tasks.description: Lists the tasks of a Planner plan.

planId.label: Plan ID
planId.description: Planner plan ID. Use List Plans to find it.

titleContains.label: Title Contains
titleContains.description: Only return tasks whose title contains this text (case-insensitive).

microsoft_365_planner_list_bucket_tasks.label: List Bucket Tasks
microsoft_365_planner_list_bucket_tasks.description: Lists the tasks in a Planner bucket.

bucketId.label: Bucket ID
bucketId.description: Planner bucket ID. Use List Buckets to find it.

microsoft_365_planner_list_my_tasks.label: List My Tasks
microsoft_365_planner_list_my_tasks.description: Lists the Planner tasks assigned to you.

microsoft_365_planner_get_task.label: Get Task
microsoft_365_planner_get_task.description: Gets a Planner task by ID.

taskId.label: Task ID
taskId.description: Planner task ID. Use List Plan Tasks, List Bucket Tasks or List My Tasks to find it.

microsoft_365_planner_create_task.label: Create Task
microsoft_365_planner_create_task.description: Creates a task in a Planner plan.

planId.label: Plan ID
planId.description: Planner plan ID. Use List Plans to find it.

bucketId.label: Bucket ID
bucketId.description: Bucket to put the task in (from List Buckets). Leave empty for the plan’s default placement.

assigneeIds.label: Assignee IDs
assigneeIds.description: User IDs to assign the task to (from List Group Members or Get Current User).

percentComplete.label: Percent Complete
percentComplete.description: Progress from 0 to 100. Planner shows 0 as not started, 1–99 as in progress and 100 as completed.

priority.label: Priority
priority.description: Priority from 0 (highest) to 10 (lowest). Planner shows 1 as urgent, 3 as important, 5 as medium and 9 as low.

categories.label: Label Categories
categories.description: Label categories to apply, e.g. ["category1", "category4"]. Get Plan Details shows each category’s name.

microsoft_365_planner_get_task_details.label: Get Task Details
microsoft_365_planner_get_task_details.description: Gets a task’s description, checklist and links.

taskId.label: Task ID
taskId.description: Planner task ID. Use List Plan Tasks, List Bucket Tasks or List My Tasks to find it.
